rateBasis: Complete pasture lifecycle; includes seeding-to-depletion time. Do not add construction downtime again.

reference.author: cmfrydos
reference.setup: Two herders, Hand Cart and second pasture upgrade, after update 147949
reference.method: Author reports two runs, one additional repeat for an outlier, timing from seeding to depletion. Limited sample; animal placement affects walking.

assumptions.source: User instruction 2026-11-11: assume pasture food credit like Khmer; use online average rates; defer in-game measurements.
assumptions.postImperialProxy: Use the reported fully upgraded carry rate as the post-Imperial average without an invented adjustment for fewer rebuilds. Use supplied DAT Imperial food yield and wood cost for renewal.
assumptions.accuracy: Approximate historical community measurement; not verified against the supplied DAT build or to less than 1%.

rejectedAlternative.reason: The calculator explicitly says pastures are not modeled; its displayed farmer rate is not a pasture reference.
